# Duplicate Function Analysis — testroom × multiplayer
*Generated by Shadow Self — Task: duplicate-code-cleanup — Cycle 1 of 5 — v839*

---

## Summary

Two layers of duplication exist in this codebase:

1. **Within testroom**: `smart.js` is a deprecated predecessor of `smartAutoPlay.js`
2. **Across directories**: `multiplayer/battle-engine.js` was extracted from `testroom/index.html` and shares 136 identically-named functions

---

## Layer 1 — Within Testroom: smart.js vs smartAutoPlay.js

### Status
`smart.js` has been **marked DEPRECATED** (cycle 1 action). Use `smartAutoPlay.js`.

### Duplicated Functions (all 8)

| Function | smart.js line | smartAutoPlay.js line | Relationship |
|---|---|---|---|
| `smartAutoPlay()` | 3 | 3 | Identical |
| `smartPlayNext()` | 12 | 12 | Identical |
| `smartTriggerEntry(team)` | 66 | 105 | smartAutoPlay.js expanded (128 vs 31 lines) |
| `smartPickSwap(team)` | 99 | 235 | smartAutoPlay.js adds Lou/Grawr buff blocking |
| `smartBlackoutPick()` | 122 | 262 | Identical |
| `smartMoonstoneChange(dice)` | 131 | 271 | Identical |
| `smartLuckyStone(dice)` | 153 | 293 | Identical |
| `smartSimRounds(gameNum)` | 160 | 300 | smartAutoPlay.js massively expanded (2609 vs 457 lines) |

**Note:** Neither file is loaded via `<script src>` in index.html — both are console-paste tools. They export the same global names and **will conflict if both are pasted**. `smartAutoPlay.js` is authoritative.

### Recommended cycle 2+ action
Safe to delete `smart.js` outright once the team confirms no one is still using it as a reference. The deprecation header added in cycle 1 serves as an interim warning.

## Layer 2 — Across Directories: testroom/index.html vs multiplayer/battle-engine.js

The multiplayer/battle-engine.js header explicitly states:
> "BATTLE ENGINE — Extracted from testroom for multiplayer use"

These two files have drifted since extraction. Below is the current duplication map.

### Byte-for-Byte Identical Utility Functions

These are safe candidates for extraction into a shared `battle-utils.js`:

| Function | testroom/index.html | multiplayer/battle-engine.js |
|---|---|---|
| `active(t)` | line 4447 | line 448 |
| `opp(team)` | line 4448 | line 449 |
| `teamName(team)` | line 4449 | line 450 |
| `log(html)` | line 4454 | line 455 |
| `hasAlive(team, id)` | line 5028 | line 948 |
| `isStraight(dice)` | line 5031 | line 951 |
| `countVal(dice, val)` | line 5059 | line 979 |
| `hasDoubles(dice)` | line 5062 | line 982 |
| `hasEvenDoubles(dice)` | line 5069 | line 989 |
| `dylanNegates(enemyTeam)` | line 5052 | line 972 |

### Diverged Functions (same name, different implementation)

These have intentionally evolved separately — do NOT blindly merge:

| Function | Difference |
|---|---|
| `hasSideline(team, id)` | testroom adds `tysonDisabled` guard; multiplayer omits it |
| `getSidelineGhost(team, id)` | Same — testroom has `tysonDisabled`; multiplayer doesn't |
| `classify(dice)` | testroom adds 6+-of-a-kind dynamic label; multiplayer caps at "penta" |
| `describeRoll(r)` | testroom has dynamic "six of a kind!!!" etc.; multiplayer is fixed |
| `startBattle()` | testroom extended with hand-limit controls and more state fields |
| `triggerEntry()` | testroom has full card-specific ability logic; multiplayer is simpler |
| `popSidelineCard()` | testroom uses `spd(1300)` helper; multiplayer hardcodes `1300` |

### Scale

- **136 identically-named functions** across both files
- These cover: ability handlers, UI modals, renderers, combat logic, resource/state helpers
- Multiplayer is missing testroom-only features: hand-limit mode, `tysonDisabled`, 6+-of-a-kind dice
